title: The Impact of Reduced Towing Fees on Vehicle Redemption Rates for Low-Income Individuals: Evidence from San Francisco's 2020 Policy

contributions.purpose: 因果估计2020年降拖车费政策对低收入车主赎车率的影响
contributions.mechanism: 差分中的差分(DiD),车龄>10年且非豪华品牌为低收入代理组,含月-年/日固定效应
contributions.domain: 公共经济学 / 市政罚款执法公平
contributions.source_quote: the August 2020 fee waiver was a highly effective intervention, causing a 3.5 percentage point increase in the vehicle redemption rate for the low-income proxy group

contributions.purpose: 揭示效应集中于"贫困拖车"且随车龄递增的异质性
contributions.mechanism: 按车龄分组三重差分(DDD)+ 按拖车类型分子样本DiD
contributions.source_quote: Poverty tows: The policy caused a large and highly significant increase of 6.1 percentage points in redemption rates. Non-poverty tows: The policy effect was much smaller, at about 1.0 percentage points

contributions.purpose: 作为对照检验程序性改革(2021)的无效性
contributions.mechanism: 同一DiD框架估计2021规则变更交互项
contributions.source_quote: the June 2021 rule change shows no measurable effect on redemption. The coefficient on Post2021 × LowIncome is small and statistically insignificant.

self_declared_provenance.quote: we follow established practice in transportation and economic research by constructing a proxy for owner socioeconomic status based on vehicle age and make [e.g., 9, 20].

notes: accept。质量较高的经济学 DiD 论文,Google Gemini 列为共同一作。3条自声明因果贡献,四元组带关键数字与SE,适配良好。负结果/trade-off:2021程序性改革无显著效应(对照检验成功)。诚实红旗(非造假,反而加分):作者自认平行趋势假设被违反——非贫困拖车事件研究显示显著正向 pre-trend,使该子群因果解释失效(充当placebo);贫困拖车为负 pre-trend,系数量级需谨慎。低收入代理有误分类衰减偏误(视为保守下界)。样本期与COVID冲击/联邦补助重叠。数据因隐私不公开、代码"upon request"(checklist Q5=No)。checklist AI披露:Hypothesis=B、设计=B、分析=C、写作=C;AI Limitations 记录 AI 三次识别错政策生效日期(应为2020-08-01),由人工核对SF交通法SEC 305后更正——关键数据日期红旗但已人工修正。注:reproducibility 相关checklist多项自答"paper does not include experiments"(NA),与实为实证研究略矛盾。
